answer: Rising join fees make every fake key pay more than the one before it. The protocol counts admissions per epoch up to a horizon of 2,000, and the nth new key burns 0.05 x n POA as a timber fee, so the 1,000th pays 50 POA. A farm's vine of keys cannot split the fee, since each key burns its own at admission with no refund. 1,000 fakes x average 25.025 POA = 25,025 POA burned, which the attacker forfeits.
